messages:
Zoe L.: FYI: timeline and quick pulse for the upcoming review cycle. Manager edits due Fri 2025-11-07 17:00 UTC. Well start the Workday ingest Mon 2025-11-10 07:00 UTC. Please read below and ping for a handoff slot.

Ben R.: Heads-up on the form: please use "Manager Review Form v5" (new competency IDs). Dont paste old CSVs into it. Link: https://go/redwood/mgr-form-v5

Marta V.: Quick checklist managers should follow:
- Verify direct report list matches org chart
- Add 10-line rationale for each numeric rating
- Attach one supporting artifact for any rating <=2
- Mark LOA/transfer with HEADER tag (see template)

Kenji T.: Contractors: put \`contractor:true\` and final_day in the header. Default is to exclude from calibration unless requested.

Zoe L.: Calibration windows: Mon 2025-11-10 13:00 UTC (90m), Mon 2025-11-10 18:00 UTC (90m). Sign up: https://go/redwood/cal-signup-2025. If you have >7 reports, request a private panel slot.

Marta V.: New managers: 25m prep slots Thu 2025-11-06 09:00 & 15:00 UTC (sign up same page). Well cover form walkthrough + evidence expectations.

Ben R.: Import note: reviewer names must match People Ops directory (case-sensitive). If ingest fails, DM me a screenshot; Ill run a targeted re-import.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Manager edits due Fri 2025-11-07 17:00 UTC" posted 2025-11-04 10:00 UTC. Reaction: :bell:

Zoe L.: Sample Slack blurb managers can copy:
```
Reminder: Manager edits due Fri 17:00 UTC. Use Manager Review Form v5 and attach evidence for any <=2 ratings. Add LOA tags in header. Workday ingest Mon 07:00 UTC. DM people-ops for a handoff slot.
```

Kenji T.: If you need a late exception (e.g., pending termination paperwork or payroll corrections), tag the form with EXCEPTION=PAYROLL or EXCEPTION=TERMINATION and flag in your signup. Those will be handled manually.

Marta V.: Ill post a final pre-ingest checklist Mon morning and close signups 2 hours before panels. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
